changelog: new: ONT-WGS — whole-genome analysis of bacterial isolates sequenced with ONT Native Barcoding / Ligation kits (e.g. SQK-NBD114-24). Chunk files from MinKNOW are merged per sample automatically and named after the sample folder (Sample_OP-SCN5 → OP-SCN5) or the barcode, fastq_fail files are left out, and sample_map.csv records which file went where. Per sample: read QC/filter (seqkit, read-GC purity check), Flye assembly, Medaka polishing (bacterial model), contig/circularity/depth table, CheckM2, species by sourmash vs GTDB + skani ANI to the closest reference, all full-length 16S copies (barrnap → vsearch, ties reported honestly), MLST, AMRFinderPlus (--plus, organism-aware), VFDB, MOB-suite + PlasmidFinder, Bakta annotation, and an HTML/PDF genome report with a chromosome map. Steps resume after a failure; missing tools are skipped with a note. New: use a folder on the analysis computer instead of uploading (files are linked, not copied); uploads now stream to disk instead of RAM. License keys gain bit 8 (ONT-WGS) — existing keys are unchanged and keep their pipelines; keygen.py issues keys with it. Install the tools once with: bash ~/r16s-app/setup_wgs.sh. Needs a backend restart and frontend build.

previous.changelog: fix: ONT 16S ran against a different Emu database from the one selected and recorded. main.py picked the Emu database as ont_db_path, else emu_db_mar2026 / emu_silva / any emu_* from db_paths.json, and only then the selection, so whenever emu_db_mar2026 existed it was used regardless of the choice. Job Detail and run_params.json showed the selected database (e.g. emu_silva/sequences.fasta) while the Emu command in the log used emu_db_mar2026. The selected database now wins when it is an Emu database (has taxonomy.tsv); the auto-lookup is only a fallback for a selection that is not, and the log says which database was used and why. Needs a backend restart.
